porch-intro.speaker: Narrator
porch-intro.text: The porch boards are warm under your sneakers. The backyard smells like sun and grass, and somewhere a secret is waiting.

bailee-snack.speaker: Bailee
bailee-snack.text: Mission: backyard adventure. But first—snack power!

tutorial-hint.speaker: Narrator
tutorial-hint.text: Tap the yard to move Bailee. Tap sparkly objects to investigate.

dutchess-entrance.speaker: Dutchess
dutchess-entrance.text: WHOOF! Wait—no. WOOF! I mean hi! The wind tried to steal my dignity!

dutchess-okay.speaker: Dutchess
dutchess-okay.text: Mostly! My tail is a little frazzled. But I found a pawprint sparkly thing!

dutchess-wind.speaker: Dutchess
dutchess-wind.text: Nope! I did a surprise wiggle-escape. The wind was like WHOOSH and I was like WEEE!

dutchess-spark.speaker: Dutchess
dutchess-spark.text: Here, take this Wonder Spark. It smells like adventure snacks.

cooler-open.speaker: Bailee
cooler-open.text: Yes! Fruit snacks and apple slices. Backpack, meet your new best friends.

chime-hint.speaker: Narrator
chime-hint.text: The chimes sing a soft note toward the shed. Something sparkly flickers by the door.

shed-locked.speaker: Bailee
shed-locked.text: Three Wonder Sparks go here. The lock is waiting for all of them.
